text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. I can’t wait for the next training session.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Actually, after I lost the race yesterday, Sky-san 
took me to the park.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
While we were walking, I noticed the flowers at my 
feet. The way they swayed in the wind looked like 
they were waving at me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I received so much energy—from the flowers, and 
from Sky-san too. That’s why I’ll do my best to win 
next time!
